scripts.build: npm -w @agentlodge/web run build && npm -w @agentlodge/server run build
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/check-layers.mjs && node scripts/check-compose.mjs && node scripts/check-i18n.mjs && npm -w @agentlodge/server run typecheck && npm -w @agentlodge/web run typecheck
scripts.trace: node scripts/ensure-trace-proxy-cjs.mjs && PROXY_PORT=${PROXY_PORT:-8796} TRACE_DIR=${TRACE_DIR:-trace-proxy/traces-chain} PROXY_RETRY=${PROXY_RETRY:-0} PROXY_MAX_CONCURRENT=${PROXY_MAX_CONCURRENT:-0} PROXY_TRACE_SKIP="${PROXY_TRACE_SKIP:-HEAD /api/hello}" node trace-proxy/proxy.js
scripts.dev:trace: concurrently -n trace,server,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "UPSTREAM_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8788 npm run trace" "GATEWAY_URL=http://host.containers.internal:8796 npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
